title: improv·artist · mythic (Anselm Kiefer)
mutation_directive: improv artist: mythic via Anselm Kiefer

improv_extras.practice: ash, lead, straw; history as wound; vast leaden landscapes

v1.feedback: Strong Kiefer reference — straw palette, scorched ground, smoldering tips all land. The back-and-forth camera oscillation (sin(t*0.07)*1.8) technically violates the 'no oscillation' preference; replace with a single slow linear dolly or fix the camera entirely. Consider adding slight vertical height variation to the ground plane to break the flat horizon — Kiefer's landscapes have geological weight, not a ruled line. The ember pulse (col += ember*0.25*pulse*vBurn) could be reduced by half to stay contemplative rather than flickering.

v2.feedback: Strong Kiefer translation — the scorched wheat field with 38K instanced straw stalks, burn-patch noise, and ember-tipped char reads as a genuine mythic landscape rather than a particle demo. Palette is exemplary (earth-dark through straw-pale, char-black, restrained ember at 0.12 intensity). Two refinements: the ember pulse frequency (uTime * 0.4) could slow further to ~0.15 so tips feel like dying coals rather than breathing; and consider adding a sparse set of thicker, broken stalk geometry (wider quads, half-height, more char) to break the uniform grass-lawn regularity and sell the post-burning violence Kiefer's surfaces demand.
